as_told.title: NASA Saturn program as a transplant of the Nazi space program

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the Saturn rockets of NASA, the US space agency, were built by Wernher von Braun and Arthur Rudolph, two German rocket engineers, along with 129 other people. As Michels puts it, the whole thing was a transplant of the Nazi rocket programme into America, and on a later show he stresses that it was "literally" that and nothing more. If so, America's great space achievement would rest directly on the work of Hitler's scientists.
